draft_en.subject: Switches for your microwave link sites and tower cabinets - three DIN configurations
draft_en.body:
Hi Wayne,

Over the past months you had a steady stream of product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 1 October 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the switches at your microwave link sites and tower cabinets, from single units, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS, EXW, 15-day validity: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based - model STI-288GPM - $82.2 USD; compact 4 x Gigabit PoE+ + 1 x Gigabit + 1 x SFP, unmanaged - STI-154GP - $39.2; 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP unmanaged, non-PoE - STI-280GE - $46. RCM stays on your side.

One question: which site configuration do your building-to-building links use most - a 4-port box per radio, or 8 ports in the cabinet?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
